1.explanation: This script launches headless Chrome via chrome-launcher, then runs Lighthouse programmatically on a small data: URL page containing 150 nested <div> tags. We run only the “dom-size” audit to isolate the behavior. When you inspect the output (the details.items), you will see values like 150.0 for Total DOM Elements, showing the unwanted ".0" decimal. This reproduces the screenshot issue where integer metrics are formatted with one decimal place by default.
1.bug_scenario: In the Lighthouse DOM Size audit (audit id “dom-size”), numeric values that will always be integers (Total DOM Elements, Maximum DOM Depth, Maximum Child Elements) are being formatted with a decimal fraction “.0” (e.g. “2,008.0”) in the report’s details table.
